about: Whole-video continuity sheet (8 Nov 2026). Decided once, before scenes are built; every scene spec is built against it and the validator checks scene specs against it (toolkit scene/continuity_check.mjs). A change here after Sam's OK is a decision for Sam, not a scene fix.

chapters.light: single cool key on the lump, dark around
warm afternoon outside; lamp-lit room (warm from screen right); red then black in the eruption; dark, then heat glow as the books carbonise
amber torchlight, smoky, underground; then cool daylight in the workshop
workshop daylight, changing apparatus per era (1819 gases, 1980s gelatine)
many small screen glows around the world; one warm reveal on 'purple'
cool white beamline; the villa today under modern ground
reprise of each set's own light, ending at dawn over the bay, then the table light of the opening

sets.what: a dark table top with one lit lump on it; your hands (POV) pick it up
the Villa of the Papyri on the Bay of Naples, Vesuvius behind: terraces, long pool, bronze statues, sea wall
states: eruption: gas and ash clouds roll down (lib14-lib15)
cross-section under more than 20 m of volcanic rock (lib16)
today: modern ground over it, parts never dug out (rd20-rd21)
sets.note: one wide world; the camera travels it in every state, same layout in all of them

sets.what: the library room: racks A/B/C on the back wall, the case with the slanted stand, the lampstand
states: dark, heat: every scroll end turns black, the lamp out (lib17-lib18)
buried and filled, reached by a tunnel in 1752, torchlight, stacks of black lumps (ch5)

sets.what: narrow tunnels cut through rock, 1752, smoky torches, a bronze statue being hauled out
the papyrus workshop in Naples: one long table and window; its apparatus changes with the era (knife and scraper; Piaggio's frame; Davy's gas jars; a 1980s lab bench with gelatine)
sets.note: one room reused across 230 years: the era is told by the apparatus and a date tag, the walls stay

sets.what: a scanning lab: a scanner, a screen showing the 3D spiral of a scroll, a flattened layer; also the hospital-scan comparison and the En-Gedi scroll
screens around the world on a night map (the crowd), then one screen close: the crackle texture, the marked strokes, the training loop, the word
the ring of magnets at Grenoble seen from above, the beamline, the core on its mount
Natural Earth map of the Mediterranean, sea navy, land sand; one marker per place, labels on backings

props.size: 7 cm across, 30 cm long (open sheet 28 cm tall)
states: found again in 1752: black, among the lumps on the buried stand (ch5, labelled Illustrative); from here it is drawn as the lump

props.drawing: one carbonised-roll drawing: black, cracked, slightly crushed, same 7 cm scale
states: whole, on the table, in your hand (open1-open5, end8-end9)
stacks in the buried room, the scene-2 roll among them on the stand (ch5)
cut in half like a log, layers scraped (ch10-ch12)
edge glued to skin, silk threads, on Piaggio's frame (ch15-ch18)

props.drawing: PHerc. 1667: a black stub, small enough to sit in your palm
states: on its mount in the beamline (rd6-rd7)
unwrapped on screen, about 20 column bottoms with gaps (rd8-rd11)
props.check: its real size and shape from the 2026 team's images before drawing

props.drawing: a wooden frame, a turning screw, silk threads to skin glued on the roll's edge
states: opening a roll a sliver at a time (ch15-ch17)
props.check: period drawings of Piaggio's machine (public domain) for its shape

props.drawing: a bronze statue, generic (not a copy of a real Villa bronze)
one flat monitor drawing for every screen in the video

marks.pilot end: L3 at the stand, x 5.35 m
marks.scene 2 end: L4 at rack C, x 4.45 m, holding a roll

characters.rule: 79 AD only; not shown in the eruption

characters.kind: POV hands (kit): bare forearms, fingers over the held object, elbows just below frame
appears: ch4 (holding a torch in the tunnel)
characters.rule: the same hands every time; sized from the object they hold

characters.kind: kit rig with a 1750s costume (shirt, breeches, cap); 2-3 variants by costume and head
characters.rule: small in frame, mostly silhouetted against torchlight

characters.kind: kit rig, seated drawing pose (new pose for the kit)

who: Antonio Piaggio (portrait if a public-domain one exists, else monogram)

characters.rule: their work is shown through screens and anonymous hands labelled Illustrative

rules.screen_direction: time and journeys move left to right in every chapter; a deliberate reversal is noted in the scene's blocking plan
rules.writing: Greek capitals, rounded sigma, no spaces; only fact-checked real text is ever legible (PHerc. 1005 four-part cure; the word on cr14 and the title on rd16 after their checks); everything else is ink blocks
rules.tags: red hanging tags on shelved rolls are a look, never claimed as found at Herculaneum
rules.scale: a roll is 7 cm across in every shot; a hand is about 1.3x a roll
rules.people_harm: the eruption is shown through the villa and the room, never through victims
rules.credits: AI-GENERATED ILLUSTRATION on AI art; MAP · NATURAL EARTH on maps; Illustrative/Recreation kind labels where a scene is not a record
